assertions.rule: Every durable event kind resolves to its registered component and state-resolution family without prose inference.

No cell write declares a bottom policy. Ordinary causal_register components select a deterministic winner; sequenced_state, or_set, ordered_log and counter likewise never emit generic Bottom. Explicit cross-Cell domain diagnostics remain separate from state-model resolution.
Every referenced state model and domain transition contract has a registered reducer semantic.
Unknown component, state model, transition rule, or critical dispatch metadata is rejected before state mutation.
Every transition-constrained cell family resolves to exactly one closed domain transition contract after template instance parameters are applied; event rows never duplicate the table.
Every active actor_private_event resolves to one actor-private event write and cell-family merge contract, with no shared Realm plane/sealed contract.
